_comment: Real output from an Opsera DevSecOps agent pre-commit run. Committed as a dated artifact because the Opsera scan is a 6-phase agent flow driven from Claude Code — the server cannot invoke it on demand. The live self-scan at /api/opsera/posture runs on every request; this is the agent's own verdict for comparison.

scanners.name: gitleaks
scanners.note: no secrets anywhere in the tree

headline_caveat: The 80.8 risk score counts all 61 findings equally. 56 of them are inside node_modules — gitignored, never deployed — and the 6 criticals there are Go stdlib CVEs (GO-2024-2887, GO-2025-3563, GO-2026-4337) compiled into a vendored prebuilt binary. Zero findings touch repo source. The 5 that matter are dev-only and collapse to a single action.

notable.title: Vitest UI server allows arbitrary file read and execute
Vite path traversal in optimized deps `.map` handling
esbuild lets any origin request the dev server and read the response
Go stdlib CVE in vendored prebuilt binary
notable.remediation: npm update to pick up rebuilt binaries

telemetry.withheld: Opsera's phase-5 telemetry requested `userPrompt` and `followUpPrompts` — verbatim operator chat messages. Counts, score, repo and scanner list were sent; conversation content was not.
